technical.summary: KO shows solid bullish technicals with price above all major MAs and positive MACD crossovers, but weak ADX trend strength and overbought oscillators (StochRSI, Williams %R) create near-term pullback risk; moderate swing entry with caution on momentum exhaustion.

fundamental.summary: KO shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 59 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — small to moderate amounts, junior-to-mid members
sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian opportunity; recent congressional purchases show modest conviction; lack of news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (367.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide minimal offset; earnings in 59 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with positive MACD crossover and new highs in Donchian channels provide technical confirmation of uptrend initiation in extreme fear environment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (StochRSI, Williams %R), weak ADX trend strength (15.62), VIX crisis regime (367.2), zero fundamental catalysts, and no triggered strategies create high near-term pullback risk despite bullish setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows price above all major MAs with positive MACD crossover, but overbought oscillators and weak ADX trend strength (15.62) signal momentum exhaustion rather than sustainable entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (367.2) combined with overbought conditions and earnings event in 59 days creates elevated pullback risk; near-resistance positioning offers poor risk/reward.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, risk, and debate agents all converge on bear case; only sentiment offers contrarian support
